items.title: Eliyan raises $145 million at $1 billion valuation to ease AI chip data bottlenecks
items.summary: Eliyan, a startup that aims to ease the bottlenecks in transferring data between AI chips in data centers, ‌said on Wednesday it had raised $145 million in venture funding at a $1 billion ‌valuation.  Cisco Systems, Lumentum and an early investor in networking pioneer Mellanox before its sale to Nvidia backed the raising, ​according to Santa Clara, California-based Eliyan.  The startup is developing technology aimed at the growing list of companies that are developing their own custom AI computing chips to compete with graphics processing units from Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices.

items.title: Did Cisco's New AI and Quantum-Safe Security Alliances Just Shift Cisco Systems' (CSCO) Investment Narrative?
items.summary: In recent weeks, Intrado Life & Safety, Tech Mahindra, and SuccessKPI have each announced new integrations and partnerships with Cisco’s Webex and security platforms, while Cisco has also begun testing Aliro’s quantum networking software and joined Nvidia’s Open Secure AI Alliance to bolster open-source AI cybersecurity. Together, these moves underline Cisco’s push to embed AI, advanced security, and quantum-safe capabilities across its collaboration, networking, and contact center offerings...
